Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation and pO₂), metabolic acidosis (low pH, low total CO₂), and mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine). There is anemia (low hemoglobin), thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, and abnormal white cell differential (monocytosis, basophilia, low neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages). These findings suggest significant respiratory compromise, possible bone marrow suppression or infiltration, and renal dysfunction. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
